params.prompt: Using this real dental reception as exact reference for the space, create an elevated editorial interior photograph of the same room: same stacked-stone reception desk, gray marble counters, white-framed reception window, pale blue walls, abstract artwork and plant. Shot on medium format, warm late-afternoon window light raking across the stone, soft shadows, styled minimally with fresh white orchid and neatly stacked linen cards on the counter. Architectural Digest quality, rich tonal depth, photorealistic.
